coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward (page 612.2 x 792.5). Rule in the picture: its x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10.
how_measured: Each page is one scanned picture (1284 x 1662 px, 151 ppi) drawn over the whole page (0,0)-(612.2,792.5); an OCR text layer lies over it. Rules were found in the picture's own pixels (rows of dark pixels, 40 px or longer) and converted to points through the drawing matrix (x * 612.238/1284, y * 792.477/1662); caption words checked against both the pixels and the OCR words; every page looked at; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Scanned signature pages: the subscriber gives the amounts on page 11 and signs on page 12; a framed joint-subscriber column beside it ("both Subscribers must sign"); the company accepts at the foot of page 12.

sure_per_page.11: sure of the places; the rule beside (c)(ii) has no caption (doubt on what is written there)
sure_per_page.12: sure of the 16 subscriber rules and the acceptance date and signature; the company's name and title have no printed line (doubt)

3: underlined headings found as short strokes on pages 3-9 (e.g. "1. Subscription.", "(d) No filings."): underlined words, not blanks
"[DATE]" in (d) on page 3: bracketed text the company completes
11: the thick bar under the page number (y 105-109, the scan's page rule)
12: the frame of the joint-subscriber box (top y 137, bottom y 359, and its sides)
